en-US.description: Browser-like web search suggestions, URL detection, local browser results, favicons, and rich details inside PowerToys Command Palette.
en-US.longDescription: Universal Search Suggestions brings browser-like search behavior to PowerToys Command Palette. Live autocomplete from Google/Bing/DuckDuckGo and friends, inline answers (calculator, currency, weather, definitions), local bookmarks and history, plus an optional rich details panel with Wikipedia summaries and a streamed AI answer.
en-US.name: Universal Search Suggestions
